preconditions.description: The road width n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of safety islands m must be between 2 and the minimum of n + 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d_i <= n for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: All safety island coordinates must be within the range from 0 to n.
The green light duration g and red light duration r must both be between 1 and 1,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to cross the road, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum time as a non-negative integer.
The output must represent the minimum time required to cross the road according to the rules.
